paragraphs: Rabbi Yehoshua HaKohen be-Rabbi Nechemyah, in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name: Shocher Tov, section 80. In Rabbi Chanina bar Yitzchak’s name: Bereshit Rabbah, beginning of section 14. And Rabbi Levi bar Chayata and Rabbi Abba in Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba’s name: Rabbah, Behar, section 33. In Rabbi Yochanan ben Zakkai’s name: Shekalim, chapter 2. Rabbi Menachamah transmitted in his name: Tanchuma, Acharei.
